title: Folder View behaves poorly when in a panel
line: A Folder View in a thick top or bottom panel now shows the folder contents instead of only a big folder icon, as it already did in side panels.
explanation: The Folder View widget sets switchWidth/switchHeight so the panel shows its full representation once it has room, but switchSize() only returned a threshold for vertical panels and 0 otherwise. With a 0 threshold the panel always keeps the compact representation in horizontal panels, so a 360 px top panel showed just a huge folder icon. The change applies the same 8 grid unit threshold to every panel; thin horizontal panels still show the icon with its popup.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Show Folder View contents in thick horizontal panels

Folder View only switched to its full representation in thick vertical
panels, so a tall top or bottom panel showed a huge folder icon instead
of the folder contents. Apply the same size threshold to all panels.

BUG: 513610

patches.diff:
From 14039bea1c9f948eec3d5f1e6d86d448a0afc96b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:13:49 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: Show Folder View contents in thick
 horizontal panels

Folder View only switched to its full representation in thick vertical
panels, so a tall top or bottom panel showed a huge folder icon instead
of the folder contents. Apply the same size threshold to all panels.

BUG: 513610
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index d3f413b2df..1c568dff63 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -39,8 +39,8 @@ ContainmentItem {
     height: inPanel ? undefined : preferredFolderSize.height // Initial size when adding to e.g. desktop.
 
     function switchSize() {
-        // Support expanding into the full representation on very thick vertical panels.
-        if (inPanel && Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical) {
+        // Support expanding into the full representation on very thick panels.
+        if (inPanel) {
             return Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 8;
         }
 
--

media.caption: Pure master: 360 px top panel with a Folder View of ~/Desktop shows only a huge folder icon
With the fix: the same panel lists the folder contents

review.text: The 2-line change to switchSize() in containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml cleanly fixes issue 1 of the report (showing folder contents in thick horizontal panels, verified in before/after screenshots with thin and vertical panels preserved). However, bug 513610 reports multiple Folder View panel bugs—including the confirmed and reproduced issue 2 where spring-loaded folder popups open underneath a side panel—so closing BUG: 513610 with only issue 1 addressed leaves a major part of the report unfixed.
changes: Also fix the remaining reproducible issue(s) in bug 513610—in particular the spring-loaded folder popup opening underneath a side panel instead of above or beside it—before closing BUG: 513610.

changes: Also fix the remaining reproducible issue(s) in bug 513610—in particular the spring-loaded folder popup opening underneath a side panel instead of above or beside it—before closing BUG: 513610.

reviews.text: The one-line change (apply the 8 gridUnit switch threshold to every panel, not just vertical ones) is clean, in the right place, and the before/after shots prove issue 1 (360 px top panel shows only a folder icon) is fixed, with thin panels still compact. But the report lists four problems and the commit uses BUG: 513610 while only issue 1 is addressed: issue 2 (spring-loaded folder popup opening underneath a side panel, which the rig reproduced on master, plus the 'Empty folder' content in it), issue 3 (busy spinner that never stops, comment 1) and issue 4 (drag icon vanishing) are untouched, as the entry's own notes admit. Closing the bug with this commit would leave a reproduced defect open under a RESOLVED report.
changes: Either also fix issue 2 (spring-loaded FolderViewDialog placed under the panel; position it beside the panel / in a layer above it and make sure it shows the folder contents) and investigate issues 3-4 so BUG: 513610 really closes the report, or have the bug split first and retarget this commit with BUG: to the new 'contents not shown in horizontal panels' bug and CCBUG: 513610.
Add before/after evidence for whichever additional issues the commit claims to close.
